Form 2    31
C. I. D.
R. O. REC
Shanghai Municipal Police.    No. 686
Date 2/11/16

Central Police Station.
Novemeber 2nd 1916.

REPORT ON Yu Ah Nyong (余亞農) referred to in the attached news-
Not attached paper translation.

Made by D. S. D. Brewster.    Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector

Sir,
The prominent rebel referred to was arrested by the French
Police as stated. He was, I am informed, released on the 27th of
October last on payment of a fine of $100:00 and ordered to
find security. I am also informed that urgent representations
by Pak Wen Wei (柏文蔚) and many other rebels, were made with
the above result.

Your Obedient Servant,

WBrewster
Detective Sub-Inspector.

Chief Detective Inspector.

Lee Min Kuo Pao 30:10: '16.

表格 2    31
刑事侦缉处
收件登记
上海公共租界工部局警务处。    第 686 号
日期 1916 年 11 月 2 日

中央捕房。
1916 年 11 月 2 日。

关于附件新闻剪报（未附译文）中提及的余亞農（Yu Ah Nyong）的报告。

由 D. S. D. Brewster 撰写。    经首席侦探督察转呈

先生，
如上所述，该著名反叛分子已被法国巡捕逮捕。据我获悉，他已于上月 27 日缴纳罚款 100.00 元后获释，并被责令寻找担保人。我还获悉，柏文蔚（Pak Wen Wei）及许多其他反叛分子曾为此事进行紧急交涉，从而促成上述结果。

您忠实的仆人，

W. Brewster
副侦探督察。

首席侦探督察。

《民国日报》1916 年 10 月 30 日。
